answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 904 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mesa. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the spiral queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. The reef index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The fee repeats 7 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
